routeHint: Events in the main sidebar -> open a published event that has ticketing and a registration form (Nordic Food Alliance has many) -> Participants in the left event sidebar. The route param is the event UUID, the same one used by /event/:item.
alt: Participants screen listing attendees with name, town, ticket, RSVP and invited status
notes: Control bar: <n> persons, filter icon, Name box, Email box, RSVP select, Ticket select, Invited checkbox, refresh, Columns, Export, Invite. No t187c event has both ticketing and a registration form, so the Registration column cannot appear here; Summer Social Arlington is the ticketed contrast shot.

routeHint: Events -> Annual General Meeting Arlington (event 200240, past, no ticketing, no registration form) -> Participants. The contrast with the ticketed shot: only the RSVP column, no Ticket and no Registration column. 37 participants, 20 already set to Attended.
alt: Participant list of an event without ticketing, showing only the RSVP column with Attending, Attended and Not attending values
notes: Do NOT reuse the Summer Social Arlington UUID here: that is the ticketed event captured by event-attendees. RSVP values render as native <select> options, invisible to a text= waitFor, so wait on the Columns button.

routeHint: Events -> open a published event -> Participants -> Invite (top right), then expand Guest tickets at the bottom of the dialog. Use the class selector for Invite: text=Invite matches the Invited filter checkbox first and silently toggles the filter instead of opening the dialog.
alt: Invite participant dialog with Member and External tabs, a member search box, and the guest tickets number control
notes: Show the Member tab selected with the search field visible, plus the expanded Guest tickets control. Do not type a real member name into the search box.

routeHint: Superseded. events-ticketing/event-qr-ticket writes the same file from the public event page, where the confirmed-registration box actually renders.
alt: Event page showing a confirmed registration with its QR code
notes: DROPPED: two specs wrote /images/platform/events/event-qr-ticket.png and whichever ran last won. This one pointed at event 200436, which is now a session (sub-event) of the Annual Awards Dinner with no registrations, so it captured a bare event page with no QR code at all. events-ticketing/event-qr-ticket is the surviving source.

routeHint: Events -> open an event that has Enable speakers switched on (event -> Modify -> Features) -> Speakers in the left event sidebar.
alt: Speakers tab of an event listing speakers with profile photos, names and bios
notes: Layout is unchanged but each card now carries an edit (pencil) button next to the delete button for anyone who can manage the event, and a helper line under the list reading 'Speaker card shows role, current company and bio'. Recapture as event owner so both buttons appear.
